note: SPDX ids by class. A company profile may use only the permissive class; a personal profile may use any. Ids are matched case-insensitively, with -only and -or-later suffixes removed. An id in no class is unknown, and unknown is flagged like any unusable licence.

reasons.weak-copyleft: changes to the licensed files must be published under the same licence; linking from closed code is usually allowed but needs a legal check
reasons.copyleft: software built on it and distributed (or, for AGPL and SSPL, offered as a service) must be released under the same licence
reasons.source-available: the source is visible but commercial or competing use is restricted
reasons.unknown: no licence could be read, so no right to use it can be assumed
